app_fee.value: The graduate application fee is $45.00 (one-time, non-refundable).

fee_waiver.value: EMU waives the graduate application fee for military veterans (upon emailing veteran.services@emich.edu); no general international graduate fee waiver is published.
fee_waiver.quote: Eastern Michigan waives the application fee for military veterans. | In order for Graduate students to have their application fee waived the student must e-mail veteran.services@emich.edu to request a waiver.

gre_general.value: Set by each program; see the program record.

toefl_min.value: Minimum TOEFL iBT 85 for straight admission (effective 2026 new scale: 4.5 straight admission; 71-84 or 4.0 may qualify for ESL Placement). MyBest and Home Edition scores are accepted by the Graduate School.
toefl_min.quote: Accepted tests and minimum scores required: TOEFL: 85

also.quote: TOEFL: 85 iBT* (TOEFL Home Edition also accepted) | Effective 2026: 4.5 (straight admission) or 4 (ESL Placement & potentially 500-level/advanced speaking and writing courses)

ielts_min.value: Minimum IELTS Academic 6.5 (IELTS Indicator is also accepted).

english_waiver.value: India is on EMU's English Test Waiver country list for applicants who completed their education there; International Admissions makes the waiver decision at the time of review.
english_waiver.quote: Students who completed their education in the countries listed below are eligible for an English Test Waiver. Waiver decision will be made at the time of review. | India

also.quote: Consult the official list of English-speaking countries and territories for which applicants are not required to submit English proficiency test scores

notes: Only STEM PhD in the 18 Atlas fields is the interdisciplinary STEM-designated Ph.D. in Technology (with concentrations in Polymers and Coatings, Cybersecurity and Applied Computing, and Construction Management). EMU's other PhDs are Clinical Psychology, Educational Leadership, and Educational Studies.
